agents.name: Invoice Matching Agent

agents.human: The controller releases each close step.

agents.name: Dunning and Collections Agent
agents.desc: Writes and sends reminders for overdue invoices and tracks the answers.

agents.name: Delivery Delay Agent

agents.name: Goods Receipt Matching Agent

agents.name: Inventory Rebalancing Agent
agents.desc: Proposes stock transfers between plants to avoid shortages and excess stock.
agents.human: A planner approves each transfer above 20,000 EUR.

agents.name: Demand Sensing Agent
agents.desc: Refreshes short-term demand forecasts from orders, stock and market signals.
agents.next: Kick-off after the Inventory Rebalancing go-live.

agents.name: Supplier Onboarding Agent
agents.desc: Checks supplier documents and fills the master data request.
agents.next: Open topic for the next budget round.

agents.name: Transport Planning Copilot
agents.desc: Suggests routes and carriers for outbound shipments.
agents.next: Depends on the carrier feed.

contractModels.label: Pay as you go
contractModels.what: Every unit is billed after use at the list price. No commitment, no discount, no cap.
contractModels.fit: Flexible, but the most expensive per unit and hard to plan.

contractModels.label: Agreed consumption per year
contractModels.what: The customer commits to a yearly volume at a discounted unit price; units beyond the volume are billed as overage.
contractModels.fit: Planning security for both sides; overage needs a rule.
contractModels.terms: 120,000 units for 2026 at the agreed price of 3.00 EUR per unit (360,000 EUR a year). Overage above 120,000 units is billed at the list price of 4.20 EUR per unit.

contractModels.label: Fixed consumption per year
contractModels.what: A fixed yearly volume with a hard cap: when it is used up, agents are throttled or stopped until the next period or a top-up.
contractModels.fit: Cost is capped, but business processes can stop.

contractModels.label: Rollover
contractModels.what: Unused units move to the next period (usually capped and valid for 12 months).
contractModels.fit: Protects the customer against under-use in the ramp-up year.

contractModels.label: Prepaid credit pool
contractModels.what: One prepaid pool is drawn down by all products (Joule, AI Core, Document AI, Ariba AI).
contractModels.fit: Simple to steer across products; one number to watch.

contractModels.label: Top-up packs
contractModels.what: Extra units can be bought in fixed packs during the year at the agreed unit price, without a new contract.
contractModels.fit: Quick remedy when a product runs out early.
contractModels.terms: Packs of 10,000 units at 3.00 EUR per unit, ordered by the customer admin, effective the next day.
